idea-plugin.name: PurrLang
idea-plugin.description:
PurrLang, the language of the PurrEngine game engine.

Highlighting, completion, errors as you type, hover, go to definition, find usages, rename, formatting, parameter hints, the structure view, and each system's schedule above it, for .purr files.

It runs purrls, the language server that comes with purr: install purr first (see the install steps). Then open your game's folder, the one you'd run purr run in: every .purr file in it is one game.

server.name: PurrLang
server.description: purrls, the PurrLang language server that comes with purr.
